versions.body:
Local boards for Port Calder and a few quieter corners. Be decent, or at least be specific.

Boards are listed below. If a thread was removed, it was removed.
The city board: buses, stalls, weather, and arguments that have been running since before the software changed.
Cables, logins, and 'why is my printer doing that'.
Buses, the ferry, and the timetable as a literary form.
Where they are biting, and where they are not.
Games, sessions, and a surprisingly calm tone.

earlyboat (OP): I have been on the 6:10 for a year and I have never seen the same face twice in the wheelhouse. Is there a captain or just a rota with a hat.
harbor_hank: there is a captain. he is called Dennis and he is very real and very tired
earlyboat: then why does the tannoy sound like a different person every week
millgirl_77: because they take turns, earlyboat
quietreader: I saw Dennis buying a bun at six. He exists.

title: Route 14 after eight, is it a rumour

versions.body:
harbor_hank (OP): last three Thursday nights the 14 just didn't come. I walked. I am not a timetable.
millgirl_77: I caught the 20 past. It was late, not fictional
cablekit: the display at the stop has been stuck on 4 min since Christmas
harbor_hank: that display has been lying to this city for years

author: acc_tl_hank

title: Anyone still fishing the creek mouth

versions.body:
pier3rod (OP): going down this weekend. creek mouth or pier 3 if the wind is wrong. company welcome, advice more welcome
harbor_hank: pier 3. the creek is a puddle in August
earlyboat: I caught a boot in the creek in June. the boot had taste
pier3rod: I'll take the pier then

author: acc_tl_fish

versions.body:
pier3rod (OP): someone at the wall said the mackerel are in. I am treating this as unverified.
harbor_hank: I treated it as verified and I got two. come in the evening
quietreader: photograph or it didn't happen
pier3rod: fine, I'll go, I'll take a picture, I won't post the picture if they're not there

title: Has anyone actually got the bus wifi to work

versions.body:
cablekit (OP): I connected. I accepted a certificate I did not understand. I then loaded nothing. Is this a known state of affairs
gabe_runs: yes
savingthrow: I used my phone. the wifi is a conversation starter, not a service
cablekit: so I didn't fail, the thing failed. good.

author: acc_tl_tech

title: Password manager that doesn't lecture me

versions.body:
cablekit (OP): I would like to store a password in a place that is not a sticky note. I would not like a lecture about my character. Recommendations, not sermons.
quietreader: the one that just sits there. I can send you the name in a message
harbor_hank: I use a book. the book has not been breached
cablekit: the book is what I'm trying to get off, hank

author: acc_tl_tech

title: Weeknight session, east side, three seats

versions.body:
savingthrow (OP): we have a mid-week game with three seats going. no new systems, no one being weird about snacks. message me if that sounds like your idea of a good time
gabe_runs: I might come if I can get off the 14 in time
savingthrow: we'll start at half past, not on the dot, because of the 14
4thstreetbakes: I can bring cake. that is my entire contribution and I know it

author: acc_tl_game

title: Anyone playing anything short at the moment

versions.body:
savingthrow (OP): I have an hour in the evenings and a long game is beating me. what are people actually finishing
cablekit: a puzzle game I will not name because I am still on the third screen
gabe_runs: I run. that is not a game. I still recommend it
savingthrow: noted, I will not run

author: acc_tl_game

title: Why is the horn so close this week

versions.body:
quietreader (OP): the ferry horn has been sitting on the bedroom wall for four mornings. is there work in the channel or is it just the weather
earlyboat: fog, and they're sounding earlier
harbor_hank: both. there's a barge as well. the barge is not shy
millgirl_77: I walked to the wall at seven and could not see the far cranes. that's all it is

author: acc_tl_quiet

title: Bulk waste, did anyone actually get a slot

versions.body:
millgirl_77 (OP): I went for a slot for the old desk and the site said try again tomorrow, for three tomorrows. is the calendar real
harbor_hank: I got Thursday. I refreshed at midnight like a fool and it worked
quietreader: the city page says East side recycling is Tuesdays just now
millgirl_77: I know about the recycling. it's the desk I want gone

author: acc_tl_millgirl

title: Spring market, any actual tips this year

versions.body:
4thstreetbakes (OP): Harbor Street will be a mess, we already know. if you are going for the market, what time is not a waste of a morning
harbor_hank: before nine or not at all
pier3rod: I go late and I buy whatever is left. it is cheaper and I am calmer
4thstreetbakes: I'll try before nine and complain anyway

author: acc_tl_bakes

title: Stop display stuck again, north dock

versions.body:
earlyboat (OP): north dock display says 6 min. it has said 6 min since I arrived, which was 20 minutes ago. do I walk
harbor_hank: walk
cablekit: I reported it last month and got a reference number. the number is very handsome
earlyboat: I walked. the boat came as I left. of course it did
